name_input: ORACLE INDIA PVT LTD; ORACLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
court_cases: Multiple civil/tax matters in Indian courts (source: indiankanoon.org search for "Oracle India Private Limited", 709 documents, accessed 27.11.2026). Company appears in BOTH roles. As petitioner/appellant: Oracle India Private Limited vs Commissioner of Income Tax, Delhi HC, 25.11.2013; Oracle India Private Limited vs Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax, Delhi HC, 26.07.2017; Oracle India Private Limited vs Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax, Delhi HC, 04.03.2021; Oracle India Private Limited vs State of Karnataka, Karnataka HC, 02.08.2012 and 21.02.2014 (land/KIADB writs); Oracle India Private Limited vs The Karnataka Industrial Area Development Board, Karnataka HC, 16.04.2009; Oracle India Private Limited vs M/s Dhanuka Agritech Limited, Delhi HC, 18.05.2026. As respondent/defendant: Bangalore Electricity Supply Company vs Oracle India Private Limited, Karnataka HC, 14.08.2026; Shamraju and Company Private Limited vs Oracle India Private Limited, Karnataka HC, 26.05.2023; Sahaj-E-Village vs Oracle India Private Limited, Calcutta HC, 20.02.2015. Predominantly tax/assessment and commercial-contract disputes; no criminal matter identified in the retrieved set. Status of each individual case not verified beyond the reported judgment/order dates.
news_risk: No negative news or regulator action identified in the sources reachable during this check. CCI/competition search on Indian Kanoon returned only 2 unrelated documents (Aveva Group, BSES Rajdhani) — no CCI order against Oracle India found. RBI site search returned only procurement/tender references (e.g. RBI tender for Oracle WebCenter Content tuning, 02.08.2023), i.e. Oracle as a government supplier, not a subject of action. NOTE: the web_search backend was unavailable throughout this session (searx connection refused), so news coverage could not be swept; absence of negative news here is a coverage gap, not a clean bill.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies by Oracle India Private Limited to Russia or the CIS. Oracle Corporation (US parent) publicly suspended operations in Russia in March 2022; no India-entity shipment or contract to RF/CIS located in the sources checked. Not confirmed either way — treat as unverified, not as a negative finding.
note: Risk-only review. Sanctions: OFAC SDN/consolidated list search tool (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov, SDN list last updated 23.11.2026) is JavaScript-driven and returned no machine-readable results; UN/EU/UK/BIS lists not queried because the search backend was down. sanctions_hit therefore null = NOT VERIFIED, not cleared. Credit rating: no public rating for this entity located; null. Per project rules, court and tax litigation is not a rejection ground — noted neutrally as 'есть сложности'; the matters are ordinary tax-assessment and commercial disputes for a large MNC subsidiary. No rejection basis identified in this scope.
